🚀 Akash's Claude Code Marketplace

Your one-stop destination for powerful Claude Code plugins and skills

[![Claude Marketplace](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude_Marketplace-Official-blueviolet)](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-0-brightgreen)]()

Curated collection of production-ready tools that enhance your Claude Code experience.

--- ## 🎦 What's Included ### 🧠 **Crux Plugin** - Memory That Never Forgets **Solves Context Compaction with a Causal Graph** Never again lose the "why" behind your architectural decisions. Crux stores decisions as causal triples (CONSTRAINT → RATIONALE → DECISION) that survive context compaction. **Perfect for**: Long-term projects, team collaborations, complex architectural decisions. ### 🛡️ **Security Skills Collection** - Production-Ready Security **Enterprise-grade security skills for safe AI interactions** - **prompt-guard**: Unbreakable protection against injection and jailbreaks - **next-loading-skeleton**: Beautiful loading states for Next.js applications **Perfect for**: Production environments, security-conscious teams, public applications. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start ### 1. Add the Marketplace ```bash /plugin marketplace add akashp1712/claude-marketplace ``` ### 2. Install What You Need #### Install Crux Plugin ```bash /plugin install crux@akashp1712 ``` #### Install Individual Skills ```bash # Security protection npx skills add akashp1712/skills --skill prompt-guard # Better UX for Next.js npx skills add akashp1712/skills --skill next-loading-skeleton ``` ### 3. Start Creating! That's it! Your tools are now ready to enhance your Claude Code experience. --- ## 📋 Available Tools ### 🔧 Plugins | Plugin | Description | Use Case | |--------|-------------|----------| | **crux** | 🧠 Causal memory graph that survives context compaction | Long-term projects, architectural decisions | ### 🛡️ Skills | Skill | Description | Use Case | |-------|-------------|----------| | **prompt-guard** | 🔒 Unbreakable security against injection/jailbreaks | Production, security-critical apps | | **next-loading-skeleton** | ⚡ Beautiful loading states for Next.js | Web apps, dashboards, user experience | --- ## 🎯 Why Choose This Marketplace? ### ✅ **Quality Over Quantity** Every tool is hand-picked, thoroughly tested, and production-ready. No experimental or half-baked solutions. ### 🛡️ **Security First** All tools are designed with security as a primary concern. Prompt Guard ensures your AI interactions remain safe. ### 📚 **Excellent Documentation** Each tool includes comprehensive documentation, examples, and best practices. ### 🔄 **Regular Updates** Tools are actively maintained and updated based on community feedback and evolving needs. ### ⚡ **Zero Dependencies** Most tools work out of the box without requiring additional installations or complex setup. --- ## 🛠️ Installation Guide ### For Plugins ```bash # Add marketplace (one-time) /plugin marketplace add akashp1712/claude-marketplace # Install specific plugin /plugin install [plugin-name]@akashp1712 ``` ### For Skills ```bash # Install individual skill npx skills add akashp1712/skills --skill [skill-name] # Install all skills npx skills add akashp1712/skills ``` --- ## 📖 Documentation & Support ### Individual Tool Documentation - **Crux Plugin**: [github.com/akashp1712/claude-crux](https://github.com/akashp1712/claude-crux) - **Skills Collection**: [github.com/akashp1712/skills](https://github.com/akashp1712/skills) ### Getting Help - 🐛 **Bug Reports**: Open an issue in the respective repository - 💡 **Feature Requests**: Describe the use case and expected behavior - 📧 **Direct Contact**: Create an issue with "Question" label --- ## 🤝 Contributing Want to contribute to this marketplace? ### Adding New Tools 1. **Fork** the relevant repository 2. **Create** your tool following existing patterns 3. **Test** thoroughly in real scenarios 4. **Submit** a pull request with detailed documentation ### Tool Requirements - ✅ Production-ready and thoroughly tested - ✅ Comprehensive documentation - ✅ Clear value proposition - ✅ Security-conscious design - ✅ MIT License --- ## 📄 License This marketplace and all included tools are licensed under the **MIT License**. Feel free to use in personal and commercial projects. --- ## 🌟 Community ### Show Your Support - ⭐ **Star** this repository to help others discover these tools - 🔄 **Share** with your team and community - 🐛 **Report issues** to help improve the tools - 💡 **Suggest features** you'd like to see ### Connect - **GitHub**: [github.com/akashp1712](https://github.com/akashp1712) - **Tools**: [Crux Plugin](https://github.com/akashp1712/claude-crux) | [Skills Collection](https://github.com/akashp1712/skills) ---

🚀 Supercharge your Claude Code experience today!

Add the marketplace and start building better, faster, and more securely.
